parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see [Create a project](~~478153~~).

parameters.name: RequestDefinition
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the original request parameters used to create the task. Valid values:
- true
- false (default)

This parameter takes effect only for the following task types:

- MediaConvert
- VideoLabelClassification
- FaceClustering
- FileCompression
- ArchiveFileInspection
- FileUncompression
- PointCloudCompress
- ImageToPDF
- StoryCreation
- LocationDateClustering
- ImageSplicing
- FacesSearching.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the task that you want to query. This value is returned when you create the task.

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description: The type of the task. For valid values, see [Task type list](~~2743993~~).
